items.question: Which federal decree established the Frontline Heroes Office in the UAE?
items.fact: Federal Decree No. 95 of 2020 established the Frontline Heroes Office

items.question: Who chairs the Frontline Heroes Office in the UAE?
items.gold: H. H. Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the then Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi.
items.fact: Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed chairs the Frontline Heroes Office
